21:58.text: So he broke them to pieces,
except the biggest of them, that they might turn to it.

21:59.text: They said: "Who has done this to our âlihah
? He must indeed be one of the Zâlimun

21:60.text: They said: "We heard a young man talking against them, who is called Ibrâhîm

21:61.text: They said: "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may testify."

21:62.text: They said: "Are you the one who has done this to our gods, O Ibrâhîm

21:63.text: said: "Nay, this one, the biggest of them
did it. Ask them, if they can speak!"

21:64.text: So they turned to themselves and said: "Verily, you are the Zâlimûn

21:66.text: said: "Do you then worship besides Allâh, things that can neither profit you, nor harm you?

21:67.text: "Fie upon you, and upon that which you worship besides Allâh! Have you then no sense?"

21:68.text: They said: "Burn him and help your âlihah

21:69.text: said: "O fire! Be you coolness and safety for Ibrâhîm

21:70.text: And they wanted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

21:71.text: And We rescued him and Lût
to the land which We have blessed for the ‘Âlamîn

21:72.text: And We bestowed upon him Ishâq
